subject: Saving ‘big.data.object’ after MapReduce process on HDFS

messages.author: 580bb38be8331ff1
messages.subject: Saving ‘big.data.object’ after MapReduce process on HDFS
parts:
I start to work with rmr2 package and run some mapreduce jobs. 
I would like to ask how to save a big.data.object (let say, > 100GB) on HDFS? 

I know that function from.dfs() and save () can save a small data object on local. 
But if the object is too large, it cannot load into the RAM. I would like to save the result, how to do so?

I have checked that in function mapreduce(), I can specify the output to a directory on HDFS. Is this a proper way to do so? 
If yes, is there anything that I should be aware of?

Thanks.

messages.author: 3d5f3dae1dc6fa50
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#820] Saving ‘big.data.object’ after MapReduce process on HDFS
parts:
For Big outputs, using the output on mapreduce() is the right way. There is no client side data movement involved this way. 

Just from do a from.dfs to load the file again into R since you will run into the same issue. 

Thanks.
